sub_limits_waiting_notes: Hospital Cash benefit policy. Daily Cash Amount options Rs 500/1000/2000/3000/5000 per day. Indemnity Period 30 or 60 days/year. Time Excess 1 or 2 days (deductible).

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Illness: 100% Daily Cash; Accident: 150%; ICU: 200%; AYUSH: 100% (one only, highest applies)
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Benefit policy paid per 24-hour hospitalisation after Time Excess deductible. No indemnity for actual hospital bills.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: 100% of Daily Cash Amount for AYUSH hospitalisation

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Optional Cover: 100% Daily Cash plus 450% lumpsum on CI hospitalisation >10 days post Time Excess (37 listed CIs)

disease_wise_sub_limits.convalescence_benefit: 500% of Daily Cash Amount as lumpsum after 10 days continuous hospitalisation (once/year)
disease_wise_sub_limits.funeral_grant: 200% of Daily Cash Amount on death during hospitalisation in India
disease_wise_sub_limits.worldwide_hospi_cash: Optional Cover: 200% of Daily Cash for hospitalisation outside India (max 10 days/year, only Rs 3000/5000 Daily Cash option)

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Worldwide Hospi Cash optional cover: 200% Daily Cash, max 10 days/year
worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Available only on Rs 3000/5000 Daily Cash option as optional rider.

permanent_exclusions: Treatment outside India (except Worldwide Hospi Cash optional)
notable_exclusions_summary: Daily cash benefit policy — pays fixed daily amount for hospitalisation. Not indemnity. Time Excess deductible 1/2 days. Indemnity period capped at 30 or 60 days/year. PED 36 months.
claim_process_summary: Notification within 24 hours (emergency) or 72 hours (planned). Document submission within 30 days of discharge. Settlement within 15 days of last document.
